Card Q&A.q: Does "[Dragon], [saur] or [Ceratopsian] in one of its traits" mean that this effect's targets include [Dragonkin] in addition to [Dragon]?

Effect: [When Attacking] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Dragon], [saur], or [Ceratopsian] in one of its traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
